item.title: Research (Trial): After the move to slopryno.com, what actually keeps the custom domain working, and does any test watch it?
item.description: Our Pages deploy runs from a workflow, and GitHub ignores a CNAME file in that case; the domain lives in the repo's Pages settings. site/CNAME is harmless, but no check or test watches the real setting. Pitch for standup: post-deploy asserts the Pages domain and an HTTPS 200 on slopryno.com.

item.title: Research (Shield): Does the public repo block secrets before they land, or only alert after?
item.description: Push protection is on for slopworks along with secret scanning and Dependabot security updates, so a pushed token is blocked before it reaches history. Nothing to change; the check.py privacy gates still cover personal data, which push protection doesn't.

item.title: Research (Critic): What cheap habit catches the reasons a small product bet fails before it is built?
item.description: A premortem asks the team to assume the plan already failed and list why, which makes doubts easy to raise. Our huddles collect concerns but don't ask that question. Idea for standup: one premortem line from each role on the two small builds Ryno approved today (#148 W44, #149 W45).
